īra, īrae f.

noun, first declension

Other words

  • īrācundia, īrācundiae f. — quick temper; a fit of rage

    noun, first declension · also used · classical · Cic. Tusc. 4.27; Ter. Heaut. 5.1.47 (Lewis & Short); Traupman 157

    Proneness to anger, a hot temper, and also the rage itself: aliud īrācundum esse, aliud īrātum (Cic. Tusc. 4.27).

  • furor, furōris m. — rage, fury, madness

    noun, third declension · also used · classical · Traupman 156

Examples

  • īra furor brevis est

    anger is a short madnessHor. Ep. 1.2.62

See also angry, be cross.
